details: Junction 2026: European Tech Renaissance, the flagship event of the non-profit Junction (since 2015), near Helsinki. About 2,000 participants in teams build prototypes on partner challenges over 48 hours, with a 100K+ EUR prize pool. Open to developers, designers and business people.
